result.brief: 提出FLARE框架，用Whisper语义表征经随机投影量化器生成离散蒸馏目标，结合掩码预测与双流人脸-唇部联合建模，学习鲁棒的视觉语音表征。
result.reason: Cross-modal distillation into discrete targets with masked prediction yields visual speech representations; dual-stream face-lip encoding is a visual representation contribution, though aimed at lipreading.
